name: threat-composer-ai
//: This package is a uv/Python project with no package.json, so nx cannot infer targets from scripts the way it does for the TypeScript packages; they are declared explicitly. There is deliberately no build target: nothing is compiled, and the package is installed by the root postinstall hook. Declaring test and lint here is what lets `nx run-many -t test` reach pytest and `nx run-many -t lint` reach ruff, so the root scripts cover both languages through one graph.
